# Changelog

## 1.0.508


- feat(providers): issue #1398 — stall-recovery tuning becomes per-provider
  and data-driven. Registry entries (`customProviders:`, `models.custom:`,
  roles chain entries, `providersQueue:` entries) accept optional
  `connectTimeoutMs`/`streamIdleTimeoutMs` (strict positive-int parsing);
  resolution is **entry > the `providerTimeouts:` section > the 180 s/300 s
  defaults**, per field, and every seeded entry prints its effective values
  at boot. The wire seams (`sendWatchedProviderRequest` connect watchdog,
  `createSseIterator` idle watchdog) resolve per request URL, so all
  adapters inherit the tuning; runs without entries are byte-identical
  (AC6). Also: the retry backoff contract — a parseable delta-seconds
  `Retry-After` wins over the ladder for that attempt, hard-capped at the
  60 s ceiling (the clamp names the advertised value; `0` counts as
  absent, malformed/HTTP-date headers fall back to the ladder with a trace
  note) — and the dual retry budgets (connection-class cap 4, stream-class
  cap 3, independent counters, the terminal story carries both). Trace
  lines pin the format `budget=<connection|stream> attempt=<n>/<cap>
  delay=<ladder|server|clamp>`; the tuning report prints per-model
  p50/p95 inter-chunk gap + watchdog-fire counts with the
  `streamIdleTimeoutMs ≈ 2× p95` recipe (the production feeder lands with
  #1392's LatencyMeter).
- feat(hosts): gh-1322 — the wireAgentCore host-adoption gaps: an embed
  guide (`docs/embedding.md`, with the explicit "hosts ride wireAgentCore,
  never adk_dart" rule), the host-facing key-slot resolver
  (`AgentCoreServices.resolveKey` + `HostKeyResolver` — the effective slot
  NAME, pinned-twin drift hints identical to the CLI's migration notes,
  registry-leg `knownSlotNames`, injected env/store readers only), and
  lifecycle telemetry for in-process hosts (`AgentCoreServices.telemetry`:
  the pure interface + in-memory ring in core, the fa.log file sink behind
  `lib/io.dart`; requestStart/firstToken/turn/tool/run records with
  durations and the provider HTTP status).
- chore(ci): document the sm-kicker head-completeness codeless-head crash
  (upstream awf#15) — the factory job's `gh api` calls put `--jq` before
  `--arg`/`--argjson`, so a CODELESS branch head (2 parents, 0 changed
  files: a routine branch-sync merge with no content diff) crashes the
  job with `accepts 1 arg(s), received 4` — even when CI is fully green
  on that head, and the job's own rescue dispatch can never heal exactly
  those heads. Workaround until the upstream fix: keep the branch head
  code-bearing. Live instance: run 37193754301 on head 1fe9b1232.
- fix(messaging): gh-1180 — `schedule_message` self-chains no longer die
  silently at the agent-chatter wake cap. The idle inbox-wake gate
  (`InboxWakePolicy`, shared by the CLI and the app hosts) now exempts a
  delivered scheduled self-reminder (`[scheduled] ` prefix, from == to)
  from the 10-consecutive-wake streak: a deliberate agent-chosen cadence
  (night watch, periodic sweep) wakes forever, while foreign
  agent-to-agent chatter stays capped (anti-storm REG) and user-kind
  mail always wakes. A 30s cadence floor bounds a zero-delay
  re-schedule spin (E5). Refused wakes are visible (`[mail] wake

# Changelog

## 1.0.508


- feat(providers): issue #1398 — stall-recovery tuning becomes per-provider
  and data-driven. Registry entries (`customProviders:`, `models.custom:`,
  roles chain entries, `providersQueue:` entries) accept optional
  `connectTimeoutMs`/`streamIdleTimeoutMs` (strict positive-int parsing);
  resolution is **entry > the `providerTimeouts:` section > the 180 s/300 s
  defaults**, per field, and every seeded entry prints its effective values
  at boot. The wire seams (`sendWatchedProviderRequest` connect watchdog,
  `createSseIterator` idle watchdog) resolve per request URL, so all
  adapters inherit the tuning; runs without entries are byte-identical
  (AC6). Also: the retry backoff contract — a parseable delta-seconds
  `Retry-After` wins over the ladder for that attempt, hard-capped at the
  60 s ceiling (the clamp names the advertised value; `0` counts as
  absent, malformed/HTTP-date headers fall back to the ladder with a trace
  note) — and the dual retry budgets (connection-class cap 4, stream-class
  cap 3, independent counters, the terminal story carries both). Trace
  lines pin the format `budget=<connection|stream> attempt=<n>/<cap>
  delay=<ladder|server|clamp>`; the tuning report prints per-model
  p50/p95 inter-chunk gap + watchdog-fire counts with the
  `streamIdleTimeoutMs ≈ 2× p95` recipe (the production feeder lands with
  #1392's LatencyMeter).
- feat(hosts): gh-1322 — the wireAgentCore host-adoption gaps: an embed
  guide (`docs/embedding.md`, with the explicit "hosts ride wireAgentCore,
  never adk_dart" rule), the host-facing key-slot resolver
  (`AgentCoreServices.resolveKey` + `HostKeyResolver` — the effective slot
  NAME, pinned-twin drift hints identical to the CLI's migration notes,
  registry-leg `knownSlotNames`, injected env/store readers only), and
  lifecycle telemetry for in-process hosts (`AgentCoreServices.telemetry`:
  the pure interface + in-memory ring in core, the fa.log file sink behind
  `lib/io.dart`; requestStart/firstToken/turn/tool/run records with
  durations and the provider HTTP status).
- chore(ci): document the sm-kicker head-completeness codeless-head crash
  (upstream awf#15) — the factory job's `gh api` calls put `--jq` before
  `--arg`/`--argjson`, so a CODELESS branch head (2 parents, 0 changed
  files: a routine branch-sync merge with no content diff) crashes the
  job with `accepts 1 arg(s), received 4` — even when CI is fully green
  on that head, and the job's own rescue dispatch can never heal exactly
  those heads. Workaround until the upstream fix: keep the branch head
  code-bearing. Live instance: run 37193754301 on head 1fe9b1232.
- fix(messaging): gh-1180 — `schedule_message` self-chains no longer die
  silently at the agent-chatter wake cap. The idle inbox-wake gate
  (`InboxWakePolicy`, shared by the CLI and the app hosts) now exempts a
  delivered scheduled self-reminder (`[scheduled] ` prefix, from == to)

# Changelog

## 1.0.508


- feat(providers): issue #1398 — stall-recovery tuning becomes per-provider
  and data-driven. Registry entries (`customProviders:`, `models.custom:`,
  roles chain entries, `providersQueue:` entries) accept optional
  `connectTimeoutMs`/`streamIdleTimeoutMs` (strict positive-int parsing);
  resolution is **entry > the `providerTimeouts:` section > the 180 s/300 s
  defaults**, per field, and every seeded entry prints its effective values
  at boot. The wire seams (`sendWatchedProviderRequest` connect watchdog,
  `createSseIterator` idle watchdog) resolve per request URL, so all
  adapters inherit the tuning; runs without entries are byte-identical
  (AC6). Also: the retry backoff contract — a parseable delta-seconds
  `Retry-After` wins over the ladder for that attempt, hard-capped at the
  60 s ceiling (the clamp names the advertised value; `0` counts as
  absent, malformed/HTTP-date headers fall back to the ladder with a trace
  note) — and the dual retry budgets (connection-class cap 4, stream-class
  cap 3, independent counters, the terminal story carries both). Trace
  lines pin the format `budget=<connection|stream> attempt=<n>/<cap>
  delay=<ladder|server|clamp>`; the tuning report prints per-model
  p50/p95 inter-chunk gap + watchdog-fire counts with the
  `streamIdleTimeoutMs ≈ 2× p95` recipe (the production feeder lands with
  #1392's LatencyMeter).
- feat(hosts): gh-1322 — the wireAgentCore host-adoption gaps: an embed
  guide (`docs/embedding.md`, with the explicit "hosts ride wireAgentCore,
  never adk_dart" rule), the host-facing key-slot resolver
  (`AgentCoreServices.resolveKey` + `HostKeyResolver` — the effective slot
  NAME, pinned-twin drift hints identical to the CLI's migration notes,
  registry-leg `knownSlotNames`, injected env/store readers only), and
  lifecycle telemetry for in-process hosts (`AgentCoreServices.telemetry`:
  the pure interface + in-memory ring in core, the fa.log file sink behind
  `lib/io.dart`; requestStart/firstToken/turn/tool/run records with
  durations and the provider HTTP status).
- chore(ci): document the sm-kicker head-completeness codeless-head crash
  (upstream awf#15) — the factory job's `gh api` calls put `--jq` before
  `--arg`/`--argjson`, so a CODELESS branch head (2 parents, 0 changed
  files: a routine branch-sync merge with no content diff) crashes the
  job with `accepts 1 arg(s), received 4` — even when CI is fully green
  on that head, and the job's own rescue dispatch can never heal exactly
  those heads. Workaround until the upstream fix: keep the branch head
  code-bearing. Live instance: run 37193754301 on head 1fe9b1232.
- fix(messaging): gh-1180 — `schedule_message` self-chains no longer die
  silently at the agent-chatter wake cap. The idle inbox-wake gate
  (`InboxWakePolicy`, shared by the CLI and the app hosts) now exempts a
  delivered scheduled self-reminder (`[scheduled] ` prefix, from == to)
  from the 10-consecutive-wake streak: a deliberate agent-chosen cadence
  (night watch, periodic sweep) wakes forever, while foreign
  agent-to-agent chatter stays capped (anti-storm REG) and user-kind
  mail always wakes. A 30s cadence floor bounds a zero-delay
  re-schedule spin (E5). Refused wakes are visible (`[mail] wake
  refused`, once per episode) and every lifecycle step is receipted to
  `<messagesRoot>/_scheduled/receipts.jsonl` (`ScheduledReceiptLog`):
  scheduled / delivered / delivery_failed / scan_failed /
  wake_attempted / turn_started / wake_refused. A failed scheduler scan
  (transient `listDir` error) now re-arms at `failureBackoff` with an
  `onError` log instead of silently disarming the delivery heartbeat.

# Changelog

## 1.0.508


- feat(providers): issue #1398 — stall-recovery tuning becomes per-provider
  and data-driven. Registry entries (`customProviders:`, `models.custom:`,
  roles chain entries, `providersQueue:` entries) accept optional
  `connectTimeoutMs`/`streamIdleTimeoutMs` (strict positive-int parsing);
  resolution is **entry > the `providerTimeouts:` section > the 180 s/300 s
  defaults**, per field, and every seeded entry prints its effective values
  at boot. The wire seams (`sendWatchedProviderRequest` connect watchdog,
  `createSseIterator` idle watchdog) resolve per request URL, so all
  adapters inherit the tuning; runs without entries are byte-identical
  (AC6). Also: the retry backoff contract — a parseable delta-seconds
  `Retry-After` wins over the ladder for that attempt, hard-capped at the
  60 s ceiling (the clamp names the advertised value; `0` counts as
  absent, malformed/HTTP-date headers fall back to the ladder with a trace
  note) — and the dual retry budgets (connection-class cap 4, stream-class
  cap 3, independent counters, the terminal story carries both). Trace
  lines pin the format `budget=<connection|stream> attempt=<n>/<cap>
  delay=<ladder|server|clamp>`; the tuning report prints per-model
  p50/p95 inter-chunk gap + watchdog-fire counts with the
  `streamIdleTimeoutMs ≈ 2× p95` recipe (the production feeder lands with
  #1392's LatencyMeter).
- feat(hosts): gh-1322 — the wireAgentCore host-adoption gaps: an embed
  guide (`docs/embedding.md`, with the explicit "hosts ride wireAgentCore,
  never adk_dart" rule), the host-facing key-slot resolver
  (`AgentCoreServices.resolveKey` + `HostKeyResolver` — the effective slot
  NAME, pinned-twin drift hints identical to the CLI's migration notes,
  registry-leg `knownSlotNames`, injected env/store readers only), and
  lifecycle telemetry for in-process hosts (`AgentCoreServices.telemetry`:
  the pure interface + in-memory ring in core, the fa.log file sink behind
  `lib/io.dart`; requestStart/firstToken/turn/tool/run records with
  durations and the provider HTTP status).
- chore(ci): document the sm-kicker head-completeness codeless-head crash
  (upstream awf#15) — the factory job's `gh api` calls put `--jq` before
  `--arg`/`--argjson`, so a CODELESS branch head (2 parents, 0 changed
  files: a routine branch-sync merge with no content diff) crashes the
  job with `accepts 1 arg(s), received 4` — even when CI is fully green
  on that head, and the job's own rescue dispatch can never heal exactly

# Changelog

## 1.0.508


- feat(providers): issue #1398 — stall-recovery tuning becomes per-provider
  and data-driven. Registry entries (`customProviders:`, `models.custom:`,
  roles chain entries, `providersQueue:` entries) accept optional
  `connectTimeoutMs`/`streamIdleTimeoutMs` (strict positive-int parsing);
  resolution is **entry > the `providerTimeouts:` section > the 180 s/300 s
  defaults**, per field, and every seeded entry prints its effective values
  at boot. The wire seams (`sendWatchedProviderRequest` connect watchdog,
  `createSseIterator` idle watchdog) resolve per request URL, so all
  adapters inherit the tuning; runs without entries are byte-identical
  (AC6). Also: the retry backoff contract — a parseable delta-seconds
  `Retry-After` wins over the ladder for that attempt, hard-capped at the
  60 s ceiling (the clamp names the advertised value; `0` counts as
  absent, malformed/HTTP-date headers fall back to the ladder with a trace
  note) — and the dual retry budgets (connection-class cap 4, stream-class
  cap 3, independent counters, the terminal story carries both). Trace
  lines pin the format `budget=<connection|stream> attempt=<n>/<cap>
  delay=<ladder|server|clamp>`; the tuning report prints per-model
  p50/p95 inter-chunk gap + watchdog-fire counts with the
  `streamIdleTimeoutMs ≈ 2× p95` recipe (the production feeder lands with
  #1392's LatencyMeter).
- feat(hosts): gh-1322 — the wireAgentCore host-adoption gaps: an embed
  guide (`docs/embedding.md`, with the explicit "hosts ride wireAgentCore,
  never adk_dart" rule), the host-facing key-slot resolver
  (`AgentCoreServices.resolveKey` + `HostKeyResolver` — the effective slot
  NAME, pinned-twin drift hints identical to the CLI's migration notes,
  registry-leg `knownSlotNames`, injected env/store readers only), and
  lifecycle telemetry for in-process hosts (`AgentCoreServices.telemetry`:
  the pure interface + in-memory ring in core, the fa.log file sink behind
  `lib/io.dart`; requestStart/firstToken/turn/tool/run records with
  durations and the provider HTTP status).
- chore(ci): document the sm-kicker head-completeness codeless-head crash
  (upstream awf#15) — the factory job's `gh api` calls put `--jq` before
  `--arg`/`--argjson`, so a CODELESS branch head (2 parents, 0 changed
  files: a routine branch-sync merge with no content diff) crashes the
  job with `accepts 1 arg(s), received 4` — even when CI is fully green
  on that head, and the job's own rescue dispatch can never heal exactly
  those heads. Workaround until the upstream fix: keep the branch head
  code-bearing. Live instance: run 37193754301 on head 1fe9b1232.
- fix(messaging): gh-1180 — `schedule_message` self-chains no longer die
  silently at the agent-chatter wake cap. The idle inbox-wake gate
  (`InboxWakePolicy`, shared by the CLI and the app hosts) now exempts a
  delivered scheduled self-reminder (`[scheduled] ` prefix, from == to)
  from the 10-consecutive-wake streak: a deliberate agent-chosen cadence
  (night watch, periodic sweep) wakes forever, while foreign
  agent-to-agent chatter stays capped (anti-storm REG) and user-kind
  mail always wakes. A 30s cadence floor bounds a zero-delay
  re-schedule spin (E5). Refused wakes are visible (`[mail] wake
  refused`, once per episode) and every lifecycle step is receipted to
  `<messagesRoot>/_scheduled/receipts.jsonl` (`ScheduledReceiptLog`):
  scheduled / delivered / delivery_failed / scan_failed /
  wake_attempted / turn_started / wake_refused. A failed scheduler scan
  (transient `listDir` error) now re-arms at `failureBackoff` with an
  `onError` log instead of silently disarming the delivery heartbeat.

+# Changelog

+## 1.0.508

+  roles chain entries, `providersQueue:` entries) accept optional
+  `connectTimeoutMs`/`streamIdleTimeoutMs` (strict positive-int parsing);
+  resolution is **entry > the `providerTimeouts:` section > the 180 s/300 s

+  `createSseIterator` idle watchdog) resolve per request URL, so all
+  adapters inherit the tuning; runs without entries are byte-identical
+  (AC6). Also: the retry backoff contract — a parseable delta-seconds
+  `Retry-After` wins over the ladder for that attempt, hard-capped at the
+  60 s ceiling (the clamp names the advertised value; `0` counts as
+  absent, malformed/HTTP-date headers fall back to the ladder with a trace

# Changelog

## 1.0.541

- feat(usage): gh-1460 — the `fa-tokens:` segment-close line carries the
  session's model id, so every token row the factory publishes is
  attributable to a model and therefore priceable. The fold now captures
  each segment's LAST-SEEN model id (the model that served the final
  request, the same string settings/UI display — mid-session fallback
  take-overs attribute the segment to the model that actually finished it;
  zero-filled fallbacks never clobber a seen model) and the pinned line
  shape grows an OPTIONAL `"model":"<id>"` key after `"segment"` — omitted
  when no model was observed, so legacy lines parse unchanged and the
  pinned regex (`usageTokensLogPattern`, gh-1241 AC7) keeps matching both
  shapes. usage.json's schema is untouched (the model is rebuildable from
  the chain, I6); old consumers using tolerant JSON ignore the new key,
  and the repo's single strict consumer (the pinned constant) is updated
  in the same change.

## 1.0.541

- feat(usage): gh-1460 — the `fa-tokens:` segment-close line carries the
  session's model id, so every token row the factory publishes is
  attributable to a model and therefore priceable. The fold now captures
  each segment's LAST-SEEN model id (the model that served the final
  request, the same string settings/UI display — mid-session fallback
  take-overs attribute the segment to the model that actually finished it;
  zero-filled fallbacks never clobber a seen model) and the pinned line
  shape grows an OPTIONAL `"model":"<id>"` key after `"segment"` — omitted
  when no model was observed, so legacy lines parse unchanged and the
  pinned regex (`usageTokensLogPattern`, gh-1241 AC7) keeps matching both
  shapes. usage.json's schema is untouched (the model is rebuildable from
  the chain, I6); old consumers using tolerant JSON ignore the new key,
  and the repo's single strict consumer (the pinned constant) is updated

{"newText":"# Changelog

## 1.0.541

- feat(usage): gh-1460 — the `fa-tokens:` segment-close line carries the
  session's model id, so every token row the factory publishes is
  attributable to a model and therefore priceable. The fold now captures
  each segment's LAST-SEEN model id (the model that served the final
  request, the same string settings/UI display — mid-session fallback
  take-overs attribute the segment to the model that actually finished it;
  zero-filled fallbacks never clobber a seen model) and the pinned line
  shape grows an OPTIONAL `"model":"<id>"` key after `"segment"` — omitted
  when no model was observed, so legacy lines parse unchanged and the
  pinned regex (`usageTokensLogPattern`, gh-1241 AC7) keeps matching both
  shapes. usage.json's schema is untouched (the model is rebuildable from
  the chain, I6); old consumers using tolerant JSON ignore the new key,
  and the repo's single strict consumer (the pinned constant) is updated
  in the same change.

content.text:
# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.
  Study these files before writing any provider code:
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts` (~1205 LOC) — the
    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` (~1242 LOC) — includes a
    hand-rolled SSE decoder at lines 260–409; port this to Dart.
  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:
    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every
    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow
===

## 1.0.541

- feat(usage): gh-1460 — the `fa-tokens:` segment-close line carries the
  session's model id, so every token row the factory publishes is
  attributable to a model and therefore priceable. The fold now captures
  each segment's LAST-SEEN model id (the model that served the final
  request, the same string settings/UI display — mid-session fallback
  take-overs attribute the segment to the model that actually finished it;
  zero-filled fallbacks never clobber a seen model) and the pinned line
  shape grows an OPTIONAL `"model":"<id>"` key after `"segment"` — omitted
  when no model was observed, so legacy lines parse unchanged and the
  pinned regex (`usageTokensLogPattern`, gh-1241 AC7) keeps matching both
  shapes. usage.json's schema is untouched (the model is rebuildable from
  the chain, I6); old consumers using tolerant JSON ignore the new key,
  and the repo's single strict consumer (the pinned constant) is updated
  in the same change.

# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.
  Study these files before writing any provider code:
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts` (~1205 LOC) — the
    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` (~1242 LOC) — includes a
    hand-rolled SSE decoder at lines 260–409; port this to Dart.
  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:
    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every
    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow

## 1.0.541

- feat(usage): gh-1460 — the `fa-tokens:` segment-close line carries the

  shapes. usage.json's schema is untouched (the model is rebuildable from
  the chain, I6); old consumers using tolerant JSON ignore the new key,

# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.
  Study these files before writing any provider code:
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts` (~1205 LOC) — the
    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` (~1242 LOC) — includes a
    hand-rolled SSE decoder at lines 260–409; port this to Dart.
  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:
    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every
    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow
===

## 1.0.541

- feat(usage): gh-1460 — the `fa-tokens:` segment-close line carries the
  session's model id, so every token row the factory publishes is
  attributable to a model and therefore priceable. The fold now captures
  each segment's LAST-SEEN model id (the model that served the final
  request, the same string settings/UI display — mid-session fallback
  take-overs attribute the segment to the model that actually finished it;
  zero-filled fallbacks never clobber a seen model) and the pinned line
  shape grows an OPTIONAL `"model":"<id>"` key after `"segment"` — omitted

# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.
  Study these files before writing any provider code:
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts` (~1205 LOC) — the
    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` (~1242 LOC) — includes a
    hand-rolled SSE decoder at lines 260–409; port this to Dart.
  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:
    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every
    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow

# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.
  Study these files before writing any provider code:
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts` (~1205 LOC) — the
    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` (~1242 LOC) — includes a
    hand-rolled SSE decoder at lines 260–409; port this to Dart.
  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:
    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every
    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow
===

## 1.0.541

- feat(usage): gh-1460 — the `fa-tokens:` segment-close line carries the

  attributable to a model and therefore priceable. The fold now captures

  when no model was observed, so legacy lines parse unchanged and the
  pinned regex (`usageTokensLogPattern`, gh-1241 AC7) keeps matching both
  shapes. usage.json's schema is untouched (the model is rebuildable from
  the chain, I6); old consumers using tolerant JSON ignore the new key,
  and the repo's single strict consumer (the pinned constant) is updated

# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.
  Study these files before writing any provider code:
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts` (~1205 LOC) — the
    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` (~1242 LOC) — includes a
    hand-rolled SSE decoder at lines 260–409; port this to Dart.
  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:
    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every
    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow
===

## 1.0.541

  attributable to a model and therefore priceable. The fold now captures

  zero-filled fallbacks never clobber a seen model) and the pinned line

  when no model was observed, so legacy lines parse unchanged and the
  pinned regex (`usageTokensLogPattern`, gh-1241 AC7) keeps matching both
  shapes. usage.json's schema is untouched (the model is rebuildable from
  the chain, I6); old consumers using tolerant JSON ignore the new key,
  and the repo's single strict consumer (the pinned constant) is updated
  in the same change.

# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.
  Study these files before writing any provider code:
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts` (~1205 LOC) — the
    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` (~1242 LOC) — includes a
    hand-rolled SSE decoder at lines 260–409; port this to Dart.
  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:
    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every
    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow
===

## 1.0.541

- feat(usage): gh-1460 — the `fa-tokens:` segment-close line carries the
  session's model id, so every token row the factory publishes is
  attributable to a model and therefore priceable. The fold now captures
  each segment's LAST-SEEN model id (the model that served the final
  request, the same string settings/UI display — mid-session fallback
  take-overs attribute the segment to the model that actually finished it;
  zero-filled fallbacks never clobber a seen model) and the pinned line
  shape grows an OPTIONAL `"model":"<id>"` key after `"segment"` — omitted
  when no model was observed, so legacy lines parse unchanged and the
  pinned regex (`usageTokensLogPattern`, gh-1241 AC7) keeps matching both
  shapes. usage.json's schema is untouched (the model is rebuildable from
  the chain, I6); old consumers using tolerant JSON ignore the new key,
  and the repo's single strict consumer (the pinned constant) is updated
  in the same change.

# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.
  Study these files before writing any provider code:
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts` (~1205 LOC) — the
    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` (~1242 LOC) — includes a
    hand-rolled SSE decoder at lines 260–409; port this to Dart.
  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:
    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every
    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow
===

# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.
  Study these files before writing any provider code:
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts` (~1205 LOC) — the
    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` (~1242 LOC) — includes a
    hand-rolled SSE decoder at lines 260–409; port this to Dart.
  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:
    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every
    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow
===

## 1.0.541

- feat(usage): gh-1460 — the `fa-tokens:` segment-close line carries the
  session's model id, so every token row the factory publishes is
  attributable to a model and therefore priceable. The fold now captures
  each segment's LAST-SEEN model id (the model that served the final
  request, the same string settings/UI display — mid-session fallback
  take-overs attribute the segment to the model that actually finished it;
  zero-filled fallbacks never clobber a seen model) and the pinned line
  shape grows an OPTIONAL `"model":"<id>"` key after `"segment"` — omitted
  when no model was observed, so legacy lines parse unchanged and the
  pinned regex (`usageTokensLogPattern`, gh-1241 AC7) keeps matching both
  shapes. usage.json's schema is untouched (the model is rebuildable from
  the chain, I6); old consumers using tolerant JSON ignore the new key,
  and the repo's single strict consumer (the pinned constant) is updated
  in the same change.

# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.
  Study these files before writing any provider code:
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts` (~1205 LOC) — the
    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` (~1242 LOC) — includes a
    hand-rolled SSE decoder at lines 260–409; port this to Dart.
  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:
    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every
    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow
===

## 1.0.541

- feat(usage): gh-1460 — the `fa-tokens:` segment-close line carries the
  session's model id, so every token row the factory publishes is
  attributable to a model and therefore priceable. The fold now captures
  each segment's LAST-SEEN model id (the model that served the final
  request, the same string settings/UI display — mid-session fallback
  take-overs attribute the segment to the model that actually finished it;
  zero-filled fallbacks never clobber a seen model) and the pinned line
  shape grows an OPTIONAL `"model":"<id>"` key after `"segment"` — omitted
  when no model was observed, so legacy lines parse unchanged and the
  pinned regex (`usageTokensLogPattern`, gh-1241 AC7) keeps matching both
  shapes. usage.json's schema is untouched (the model is rebuildable from
  the chain, I6); old consumers using tolerant JSON ignore the new key,
  and the repo's single strict consumer (the pinned constant) is updated
  in the same change.

# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.
  Study these files before writing any provider code:
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts` (~1205 LOC) — the
    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` (~1242 LOC) — includes a
    hand-rolled SSE decoder at lines 260–409; port this to Dart.
  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:
    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every
    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow
===

# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.
  Study these files before writing any provider code:
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts` (~1205 LOC) — the
    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` (~1242 LOC) — includes a
    hand-rolled SSE decoder at lines 260–409; port this to Dart.
  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:
    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every
    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow
===

# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.
  Study these files before writing any provider code:
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts` (~1205 LOC) — the
    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` (~1242 LOC) — includes a
    hand-rolled SSE decoder at lines 260–409; port this to Dart.
  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:
    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every
    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow

## 1.0.541

- feat(usage): gh-1460 — the `fa-tokens:` segment-close line carries the
  session's model id, so every token row the factory publishes is
  attributable to a model and therefore priceable. The fold now captures
  each segment's LAST-SEEN model id (the model that served the final
  request, the same string settings/UI display — mid-session fallback
  take-overs attribute the segment to the model that actually finished it;
  zero-filled fallbacks never clobber a seen model) and the pinned line
  shape grows an OPTIONAL `"model":"<id>"` key after `"segment"` — omitted
  when no model was observed, so legacy lines parse unchanged and the
  pinned regex (`usageTokensLogPattern`, gh-1241 AC7) keeps matching both
  shapes. usage.json's schema is untouched (the model is rebuildable from
  the chain, I6); old consumers using tolerant JSON ignore the new key,
  and the repo's single strict consumer (the pinned constant) is updated
  in the same change.

# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.
  Study these files before writing any provider code:
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts` (~1205 LOC) — the
    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` (~1242 LOC) — includes a
    hand-rolled SSE decoder at lines 260–409; port this to Dart.
  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:
    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every
    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow
===

## 1.0.541

  shapes. usage.json's schema is untouched (the model is rebuildable from
  the chain, I6); old consumers using tolerant JSON ignore the new key,

# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.
  Study these files before writing any provider code:
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts` (~1205 LOC) — the
    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` (~1242 LOC) — includes a
    hand-rolled SSE decoder at lines 260–409; port this to Dart.
  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:
    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every
    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow
===

  pinned regex (`usageTokensLogPattern`, gh-1241 AC7) keeps matching both
  shapes. usage.json's schema is untouched (the model is rebuildable from
  the chain, I6); old consumers using tolerant JSON ignore the new key,

# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.
  Study these files before writing any provider code:
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts` (~1205 LOC) — the
    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` (~1242 LOC) — includes a
    hand-rolled SSE decoder at lines 260–409; port this to Dart.
  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:
    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every
    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow
===

# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.
  Study these files before writing any provider code:
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts` (~1205 LOC) — the
    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` (~1242 LOC) — includes a
    hand-rolled SSE decoder at lines 260–409; port this to Dart.
  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:
    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every
    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow
===

## 1.0.541

- feat(usage): gh-1460 — the `fa-tokens:` segment-close line carries the
  session's model id, so every token row the factory publishes is
  attributable to a model and therefore priceable. The fold now captures
  each segment's LAST-SEEN model id (the model that served the final
  request, the same string settings/UI display — mid-session fallback
  take-overs attribute the segment to the model that actually finished it;
  zero-filled fallbacks never clobber a seen model) and the pinned line
  shape grows an OPTIONAL `"model":"<id>"` key after `"segment"` — omitted
  when no model was observed, so legacy lines parse unchanged and the
  pinned regex (`usageTokensLogPattern`, gh-1241 AC7) keeps matching both
  shapes. usage.json's schema is untouched (the model is rebuildable from
  the chain, I6); old consumers using tolerant JSON ignore the new key,
  and the repo's single strict consumer (the pinned constant) is updated
  in the same change.

# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.
  Study these files before writing any provider code:
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts` (~1205 LOC) — the
    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` (~1242 LOC) — includes a
    hand-rolled SSE decoder at lines 260–409; port this to Dart.
  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:
    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every
    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow
===

blocks.text:
# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.
  Study these files before writing any provider code:
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts` (~1205 LOC) — the
    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` (~1242 LOC) — includes a
    hand-rolled SSE decoder at lines 260–409; port this to Dart.
  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:
    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every
    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow
===

# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.
  Study these files before writing any provider code:
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts` (~1205 LOC) — the
    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` (~1242 LOC) — includes a
    hand-rolled SSE decoder at lines 260–409; port this to Dart.
  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:
    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every
    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow

# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.
  Study these files before writing any provider code:
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts` (~1205 LOC) — the
    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` (~1242 LOC) — includes a
    hand-rolled SSE decoder at lines 260–409; port this to Dart.
  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:
    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every
    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow
===

## 1.0.541

- feat(usage): gh-1460 — the `fa-tokens:` segment-close line carries the

  attributable to a model and therefore priceable. The fold now captures
  each segment's LAST-SEEN model id (the model that served the final

  take-overs attribute the segment to the model that actually finished it;
  zero-filled fallbacks never clobber a seen model) and the pinned line

  when no model was observed, so legacy lines parse unchanged and the
  pinned regex (`usageTokensLogPattern`, gh-1241 AC7) keeps matching both
  shapes. usage.json's schema is untouched (the model is rebuildable from
  the chain, I6); old consumers using tolerant JSON ignore the new key,
  and the repo's single strict consumer (the pinned constant) is updated
  in the same change.

# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.
  Study these files before writing any provider code:
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts` (~1205 LOC) — the
    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` (~1242 LOC) — includes a
    hand-rolled SSE decoder at lines 260–409; port this to Dart.
  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:
    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every
    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow

## 1.0.541

- feat(usage): gh-1460 — the `fa-tokens:` segment-close line carries the
  session's model id, so every token row the factory publishes is
  attributable to a model and therefore priceable. The fold now captures
  each segment's LAST-SEEN model id (the model that served the final
  request, the same string settings/UI display — mid-session fallback
  take-overs attribute the segment to the model that actually finished it;
  zero-filled fallbacks never clobber a seen model) and the pinned line

# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.
  Study these files before writing any provider code:
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts` (~1205 LOC) — the
    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` (~1242 LOC) — includes a
    hand-rolled SSE decoder at lines 260–409; port this to Dart.
  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:
    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every
    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow
===

architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.
  Study these files before writing any provider code:
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts` (~1205 LOC) — the
    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` (~1242 LOC) — includes a
    hand-rolled SSE decoder at lines 260–409; port this to Dart.
  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:
    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every
    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow

## 1.0.541

- feat(usage): gh-1460 — the `fa-tokens:` segment-close line carries the
  session's model id, so every token row the factory publishes is
  attributable to a model and therefore priceable. The fold now captures
  each segment's LAST-SEEN model id (the model that served the final
  request, the same string settings/UI display — mid-session fallback
  take-overs attribute the segment to the model that actually finished it;
  zero-filled fallbacks never clobber a seen model) and the pinned line
  shape grows an OPTIONAL `"model":"<id>"` key after `"segment"` — omitted
  when no model was observed, so legacy lines parse unchanged and the
  pinned regex (`usageTokensLogPattern`, gh-1241 AC7) keeps matching both
  shapes. usage.json's schema is untouched (the model is rebuildable from
  the chain, I6); old consumers using tolerant JSON ignore the new key,
  and the repo's single strict consumer (the pinned constant) is updated
  in the same change.

# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.
  Study these files before writing any provider code:
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts` (~1205 LOC) — the
    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` (~1242 LOC) — includes a
    hand-rolled SSE decoder at lines 260–409; port this to Dart.
  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:
    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every
    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow
===

# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.
  Study these files before writing any provider code:
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts` (~1205 LOC) — the
    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` (~1242 LOC) — includes a
    hand-rolled SSE decoder at lines 260–409; port this to Dart.
  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:
    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every
    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow

# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.
  Study these files before writing any provider code:
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts` (~1205 LOC) — the
    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` (~1242 LOC) — includes a
    hand-rolled SSE decoder at lines 260–409; port this to Dart.
  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:
    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every
    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow
===

## 1.0.541

- feat(usage): gh-1460 — the `fa-tokens:` segment-close line carries the
  session's model id, so every token row the factory publishes is
  attributable to a model and therefore priceable. The fold now captures
  each segment's LAST-SEEN model id (the model that served the final
  request, the same string settings/UI display — mid-session fallback
  take-overs attribute the segment to the model that actually finished it;
  zero-filled fallbacks never clobber a seen model) and the pinned line
  shape grows an OPTIONAL `"model":"<id>"` key after `"segment"` — omitted
  when no model was observed, so legacy lines parse unchanged and the
  pinned regex (`usageTokensLogPattern`, gh-1241 AC7) keeps matching both
  shapes. usage.json's schema is untouched (the model is rebuildable from
  the chain, I6); old consumers using tolerant JSON ignore the new key,
  and the repo's single strict consumer (the pinned constant) is updated
  in the same change.

# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.
  Study these files before writing any provider code:
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts` (~1205 LOC) — the
    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` (~1242 LOC) — includes a
    hand-rolled SSE decoder at lines 260–409; port this to Dart.
  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:
    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every
    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow
===

blocks.text:
# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.
  Study these files before writing any provider code:
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts` (~1205 LOC) — the
    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` (~1242 LOC) — includes a
    hand-rolled SSE decoder at lines 260–409; port this to Dart.
  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:
    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every
    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow
===

blocks.text:
# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.
  Study these files before writing any provider code:
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts` (~1205 LOC) — the
    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` (~1242 LOC) — includes a
    hand-rolled SSE decoder at lines 260–409; port this to Dart.
  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:
    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every
    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow
===

# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.
  Study these files before writing any provider code:
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts` (~1205 LOC) — the
    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` (~1242 LOC) — includes a
    hand-rolled SSE decoder at lines 260–409; port this to Dart.
  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:
    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every
    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow
===

1. `usage_log_line.dart` regex `(?:,"model":"[^"]*")?` + builder's conditional key — covered: with model (exact string, all sources, regex match), without model (exact legacy string, regex match, no "model" key), position-strict rejection.

4. `UsageChainSegment.model` — covered.
5. `_ScanSegment.addRequest` + lastModel — covered: last-seen wins (2 requests, different models), resume split, fallback-no-clobber, fallback-only → null.

Edge NOT covered: model present but EMPTY string (`model.isNotEmpty` guard in builder). Hmm — can FoldRequest.model be empty? `_foldAssistant` falls back to `unknownUsageModel` for null; a record with `"model": ""` would produce empty. The builder guard handles it, but no test hits it. Per TDD aim-100% coverage, add a tiny test: a segment with `model: ''` → legacy shape. Cheap to add — but the suite is already running... Rule B5/B6: don't edit while verification in flight; if I add it, the running suite's result is stale and I re-run. The full suite takes ~40min. Is it worth it? Hmm, decision: adding the empty-string test is cheap and the right thing for coverage. But re-running the whole 40-min suite... The full suite run serves as regression proof; a one-line test addition after it invalidates it formally. Alternative: add the test NOW, kill the current run (it just started), and restart. The run just started (~1 min in) — killing and restarting costs little and keeps "verify against a frozen tree" clean.

Actually wait — do I also want a test for a line where model contains characters like dots/slashes (already: 'openai/gpt-5.2' ✓). Empty-string model: `segment(model: '')` → expect legacy exact shape. The chain never produces '' (falls back to 'unknown') unless a record literally has `"model": ""` — then lastModel = '' (empty != unknownUsageModel) and the builder omits it. Hmm — should the scanner also skip empty models? `if (request.model != unknownUsageModel)` — an empty model would become lastModel=''. Then UsageSegment.model='' → builder omits → legacy line. That's the desired behavior anyway. But strictly, an empty string is "no model observed" — cleaner to also guard in the scanner: `if (request.model.isNotEmpty && request.model != unknownUsageModel)`. - builder: segment(model: '') → legacy shape.

5. `_ScanSegment.addRequest` + lastModel — covered: last-seen wins (2 requests, different models), resume split, fallback-no-clobber, fallback-only → null.

Edge NOT covered: model present but EMPTY string (`model.isNotEmpty` guard in builder). Hmm — can FoldRequest.model be empty? `_foldAssistant` falls back to `unknownUsageModel` for null; a record with `"model": ""` would produce empty. The builder guard handles it, but no test hits it. Per TDD aim-100% coverage, add a tiny test: a segment with `model: ''` → legacy shape. Cheap to add — but the suite is already running... Rule B5/B6: don't edit while verification in flight; if I add it, the running suite's result is stale and I re-run. The full suite takes ~40min. Is it worth it?
